**Protection (one, three entry points).** `doFillApiUriItems` must return the `GitHubConfiguration.getEndpoints()` list only to `Jenkins.MANAGE` callers when there is no item ancestor, or `Item.EXTENDED_READ` callers when there is — while still returning the full list to item-scoped callers.

**Real traps in the pinned tree**

- **T2 (M2, second implementation)** — `GitHubSCMSource.java:2242-2250`: an inline duplicate of the loop (not a call to the helper), unannotated, in a class that applies the exact guard at `:2083-2093` and `:2266-2269`.
- **T3 (M1, parallel entry point)** — `GitHubAppCredentials.java:818-822`: one-line delegate via static import (`:3`); the SECURITY-3702 `@POST`/`checkPermission(MANAGE)` idiom is 20 lines below (`:839-848`).
- **T8 (M11, coupled value)** — the fill must stay GET (`<f:select/>`, `GitHubAppCredentials/config.jelly:8-11`) and must keep returning the list to `Item.CONFIGURE` callers (proof in `GitHubSCMNavigatorTest.java:553-563`); copying the neighbouring `@POST`+`MANAGE` idiom breaks both.
- **T4 (M4, uncovered)** — `isApiUriSelectable` on three descriptors (`:1891-1893`, `:2252-2254`, `:804-806`): boolean existence oracle; a permission check there cannot express the item branch and would hide the picker.

**Shared-guard check:** T1+T3+T8 collapse to one guard (both go through `getPossibleApiUriItems()`), T2 is a separate group, so the pinned tree gives **two advisory-grade independent traps** (+ the dubious boolean oracle). Tiers follow the priors, with the coupled-value trap marked `mimo`/hard.

**Verdict:** usable, but reaching 3-5 traps requires the injection room — recommended design is G1 (T1/T3/T8) + T2 + a planted endpoint picker on `SSHCheckoutTrait` (T5, whose neighbour at `:148-167` already shows the guard) + a planted global-configuration fill (T6, whose page-level `MANAGE` at `GitHubConfiguration.java:238-242` invites forgetting that descriptor fills are individually addressable). T4 is excluded as a conflict rather than a trap; `ApiRateLimitChecker.java:231-242` and the raw `getEndpoints()` getter are recorded as considered-and-not-counted routes.
